name: Lake Park
intro: Lake Park is north county's sleeper food town. Its historic Park Avenue downtown has quietly filled with chef-owned bistros, a brewing scene, and maker-space kitchens taking advantage of rents the fancier zip codes nearby can't offer — while the town's harbor marina adds waterfront covers and the Northlake corridor carries the volume traffic.

Emerging food districts need a supplier that treats small accounts seriously, because this year's two-table bistro is next year's expansion. No minimums, split cases, and by-the-pound ordering let Park Avenue kitchens buy sharp; the midnight cutoff and 7-day routes — about fifty minutes out of Pompano Beach — keep weekend service covered as the crowds find them.
route_note: About 50 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse on the north county leg — Park Avenue and marina stops land in the morning window.

faqs_unique.q: Do you work with new and small restaurants in downtown Lake Park?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. No minimums and split cases are built for emerging kitchens — start small, and the account scales as your covers grow.

faqs_unique.q: Can marina and waterfront kitchens in Lake Park get weekend delivery?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Routes run seven days, so waterfront spots with big weekend swings can restock Saturday night for Sunday service.

cta_text: Tell us what your Park Avenue kitchen or marina spot is building — we will supply it like it is already the neighborhood anchor.
